description: 詹姆斯·西蒙斯（Jim Simons）创立的文艺复兴科技是量化交易的鼻祖。其旗舰“大奖章基金”通过极其复杂的数学模型和海量数据进行统计套利，实现了历史上最高的风险调整后收益。公司大量雇佣数学家和物理学家，而非传统金融人才。其策略高度机密且封闭，旨在捕捉市场中微小的非随机价格偏离。

description_en: Renaissance Technologies, founded by Jim Simons, is the pioneer of quantitative trading. Its flagship Medallion Fund uses highly complex mathematical models and massive datasets for statistical arbitrage, producing some of the best risk-adjusted returns in history. The firm hires mathematicians and physicists rather than traditional finance professionals, keeps its strategies highly secretive, and seeks tiny non-random pricing anomalies.
